concepts.source_evidence: The Ever-Evolving 1 World of Science The Ever-Evolving World of Science We hope you enjoyed your adventures with Curiosity in Grade 6, and are now ready to continue our journey into the wonderful world of science.

concepts.name: Evidence and reasoning
concepts.definition: Use source information, observation or valid working to support a conclusion.
concepts.source_evidence: This again, is not just a textbook with facts — it is an invitation to question, to perform experiments, and to explore, as we try to understand the beautiful world we live in.

concepts.name: Application and transfer

concepts.source_evidence: The world of science covers everything — small and large, near and far.
